topics.title: Nerandomilast SSc/SSc-ILD Indication – China Development Strategy (Information Sharing & Advice Collection)

background.text: China development strategy for Nerandomilast SSc indication presented for information sharing and advice collection at PEC on 15 Dec 2025. PEC raised concern about potential risks for obtaining approval for SSc/SSc-ILD indication in China.
background.quote: PEC suggested team to formally communicate with the global team regarding the potential risks associated with obtaining approval for the SSc/SSc-ILD indication in China and maintain a written record of the communication.

todo.text: Bo Wang to formally communicate with the global team regarding potential risks for SSc/SSc-ILD indication approval in China and maintain a written record; follow up at Next PEC. Status: not yet completed (原文未说明完成状态).
todo.quote: Responsible person: Bo Wang | Timeline: Next PEC
